case.short_input: Hinglish resume vs Frontend Intern JD
case.expected: Understands the content and replies in English; rewritten bullets in English

analysis.score_reason: The candidate has core React and Node.js skills but lacks critical requirements like TypeScript, CSS, and testing frameworks. The resume structure is informal and lacks professional depth.

missing_skills.jd_evidence: Experience with TypeScript in a real project
Working knowledge of responsive CSS and cross-browser testing
Exposure to unit testing with Jest or a similar framework

weak_bullet_ids.original: Maine ek e-commerce website banayi thi React aur Node.js use karke, jisme payment gateway bhi integrate kiya tha.
weak_bullet_ids.problem: Use of informal language (Hinglish) and lack of professional tone.

weak_bullet_ids.original: Company ke backend pe kaam kiya, mostly APIs banayi aur bugs fix kiye.
weak_bullet_ids.problem: Vague description; lacks specific technical details or outcomes.

red_flags: Use of informal language (Hinglish) in project descriptions
Lack of professional formatting and standard resume structure
Missing critical technical requirements like TypeScript and Testing

rewrites.original: Maine ek e-commerce website banayi thi React aur Node.js use karke, jisme payment gateway bhi integrate kiya tha.
rewrites.improved: Developed a full-stack e-commerce website using React and Node.js, featuring integrated payment gateway functionality for secure transactions.
rewrites.why_better: Replaces informal language with professional terminology and clearly defines the technical scope of the project.

rewrites.original: Company ke backend pe kaam kiya, mostly APIs banayi aur bugs fix kiye.
rewrites.improved: Contributed to backend development at Softcore Solutions by designing and implementing RESTful APIs and resolving critical system bugs.
rewrites.why_better: Uses professional action verbs and specifies the nature of the backend work performed during the internship.

note: content understood, feedback returned in English
